anomalies.description: Composite Triple-Wing Structure Under Single Registration: Sanction covers luxury residential towers (Wings A & B), an extensive 553-bay MCGM Public Car Parking Lot, and an 8-storey Wing C for Housing Displaced (HD) tenements.
